text:
sophia_finance: NexoHealth disputed invoice NH-2026-04. They were charged $1,850 in burst fees on Apr 9 and say it coincided with our partial outage.

carl_sales: Context: Dedicated commit = $7,200/mo (2xA100 equiv). Spike around 08:20 UTC, burst used ~3.2h.

jess_csm: Support case CASE-14380: customer reports increased 5xxs and retries 08:18-11:45 UTC. They're asking for overage removal or SLA credit.

ops_mateo: Infra shows control-plane leader election issue at 08:19; measured partial degradation = 2.75h. Root cause: leader election timeout bug; fix merged.

billing-bot: Invoice NH-2026-04: Reserved commit = $7,200; Burst/overage = $1,850; SLA credit = $0; Total = $9,050.

sophia_finance: SLA: "Partial degradation >=2h and <4h -> 12% credit of monthly fee" -> 12% of $7,200 = $864. Options: (A) SLA credit only (invoice = $8,186), (B) waive overage + SLA credit total concession $2,714 -> invoice = $6,336. Waiving overage is a write-off; need RevOps sign-off for B.

maya_revops: I can approve up to $3k if Ops provides a one-line RCA in the case.

carl_sales: Customer prefers overage removal and asked for a brief note they can share with internal billing.

ops_mateo: I'll add RCA line to CASE-14380 now. Ops recommends option B.

maya_revops: Approved. Record: concession_type=one_time_writeoff; waived_overage=$1,850; sla_credit=$864; total_concession=$2,714.

sophia_finance: Creating credit memo CM-2026-078 and corrected invoice NH-2026-04-C. Draft reply: "We've applied a $2,714 concession (SLA credit + one-time waiver) and issued a corrected invoice. Apologies for the disruption; CASE-14380 has the RCA." Will post and update AR.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-078 created. Corrected invoice NH-2026-04-C issued.

jess_csm: Customer replied: "Thank you 1 appreciate the fast handling." :thumbsup:
